what: Deploy to Workers button rehearsal: root wrangler.jsonc only, throwaway names, fresh resources, then teardown.

steps.cmd: sed rename name/database_name/bucket_name to blackbox-buttontest* > wrangler.buttontest.jsonc; bun run build; wrangler deploy -c wrangler.buttontest.jsonc --i-know-its-public
steps.note: --i-know-its-public skips the local guardrail hook. The hook guessed the wrong workers.dev subdomain and blocks every public workers.dev deploy. The button deploy is public on purpose.
output: All resources provisioned, continuing with deployment...

steps.output: none: the core runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on each request (ensureSchema)

steps.cmd: teardown: wrangler delete --name blackbox-buttontest --force; API DELETE of 2 R2 objects; DELETE r2/buckets/blackbox-buttontest-logs; DELETE d1/database/9c64025f-e461-4f23-83d4-cd915ca7e0e1
steps.output: worker deleted; R2 objects and bucket success:true; D1 success:true
